what: The switch for author-check answers that await the checker's confirmation (raised in the review of 2026-10-23). An entry is applied only when its status is "confirmed"; while it is "pending" or "answer stands", every number uses the answer as given. To apply a confirmation, set its status to "confirmed", record who confirmed it and when, and rerun scripts/author_check/score.py. results.json always also carries the scores as given and the scores if every pending answer were confirmed. No checker and no item is ever dropped.
